title: Basil-Balsamic Spaghetti with White Beans, Eggplant, Tomato & Feta

steps.text: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes; drain and set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add eggplant and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown, 8-10 minutes. Transfer eggplant to a plate. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans; place in a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the beans.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons; add half to the bowl. (Reserve remaining basil for garnish.)
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl.

Return skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom; add beans, garlic, basil, tomatoes, vinegar, salt, and crushed red pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until beans are warmed through, 5-6 minutes.
Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Add drained pasta and eggplant to the skillet; toss to combine. Continue to cook until pasta and eggplant are warmed through, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls; top with feta and reserved basil. Enjoy!
